## Purpose

James AI is an AI product and UX portfolio with a living resume assistant for James Earl Lane. The human site is intentionally visual and interactive. This file gives LLMs and AI agents a stable text version of the same core information.

## Professional Summary

James Lane designs user-facing systems for decisions, AI output, and complex workflows. He combines product thinking, interaction design, responsive frontend implementation, and AI system design across React, TypeScript, Vite, Firebase, FastAPI, and LLM-enabled workflows.

His current resume identifies ongoing work as AI Product Builder at JamesLaneAI.com. His prior roles include Claims Examiner I at Capital Blue Cross from 2025 through 2026 and enterprise systems support for ICU Medical via Randstad from 2018 through 2025.

His background spans healthcare claims operations and enterprise IT support. The public work shows how he turns ambiguous requirements into interaction models with explicit constraints, evidence, tradeoffs, and human review.

At Capital Blue Cross, James designed a PHI-safe claims AI assistant pilot for complex claims workflows, including source grounding, linked-step navigation, human review, governance boundaries, and structured A/B evaluation.

## Strongest Evidence Pattern

The recurring pattern is that James:

- learns through active construction
- turns ambiguous needs into clear interaction flows and constraints
- uses AI to prototype, test, and explain workflow decisions
- makes evidence, tradeoffs, and human review visible in the product
- verifies behavior with tests, builds, browser checks, and deployment checks
- prefers evidence, verification, and clear boundaries over vague claims
- produces usable demos and explainers rather than stopping at abstract ideas

## Role Fit

Strong-fit areas include:

- business analysis
- process improvement
- workflow design
- AI experience design
- internal tooling
- decision-support workflows
- assistant design with visible evidence and review paths
- technical support escalation
- requirements discovery
- structured documentation
- practical data/reporting workflows

Stretch-fit cases should be explained honestly: James may not always match conventional credential filters, but the underlying reasoning style, self-directed learning pattern, and practical systems orientation can create real upside when a role values artifacts, ramp speed, and clear thinking.

Higher-risk environments include vague, politics-heavy, phone-heavy, interruption-heavy, noisy, rigidly onsite, or socially coded workplaces where expectations are implied rather than explicit.

## Assistant Architecture

The site uses a lightweight RAG-style assistant. It includes:

- Vite and vanilla JavaScript frontend
- Tailwind CSS and custom CSS
- Firebase Hosting
- Firebase Cloud Functions with Node.js 22
- Claude API integration through the backend synthesize function
- a structured local source corpus
- custom retrieval, intent routing, scoring, and source-bound answer generation
- tests and scripted verification for common questions

This is fair to call lightweight retrieval-augmented generation. It is not an enterprise vector database implementation unless embeddings/vector indexing are added later.

## Live Projects

- Delivery Composer: https://composer.jamesai.space/ and https://github.com/Angry-TacoZ/delivery-composer. Synthetic-data delivery-team composition demo with explicit constraints, attributable scoring, candidate comparison, revision deltas, and human approval. The public deployment uses deterministic portfolio mode; planned database and model adapters are not public capability.
- Blue - Ambient Shopping Agent: https://angry-tacoz.github.io/best-buy-blue-concept/ and https://github.com/Angry-TacoZ/best-buy-blue-concept. Independent retail AI concept with inspectable browser-local memory, deterministic recommendations, fictional data, and no external APIs, authentication, checkout, or tracking.
- PDF Equipment Checker: https://pdf-checker-fcd6c.web.app/ and https://github.com/Angry-TacoZ/pdf-equipment-checker. Deterministic tool that compares equipment schedule rows with plan-drawing tags and reports missing, mismatched, and ambiguous results.
- Personal Job Discovery: https://github.com/Angry-TacoZ/personal-job-discovery. Local-first single-user Python application that monitors public ATS feeds, stores validated listings in SQLite, and explains deterministic match scores. It is not a public job board, private-page crawler, or LLM application.
- Fieldline - Decision Continuity Artifact: https://github.com/Angry-TacoZ/ai-native-aec-product-design. Speculative local-only AEC product exercise; its approvals, handoff, content, and integrations are simulated.
- Race Telemetry Simulator: https://github.com/Angry-TacoZ/race-telemetry. Local deterministic telemetry dashboard with simulated warning states, not connected to a vehicle, backend, database, or external API.
- Living Resume AI: https://james-lane-web-resume.web.app/

## Health And Accessibility

James has approved the site assistant to discuss self-disclosed health and neurodivergence context when relevant to work design, accommodations, remote/hybrid preference, onsite constraints, strengths, and limitations.

This context should be handled with restraint. Do not lead with it for ordinary employer-facing answers unless the question asks about health, disability, accommodations, work location, sensory environment, executive function, or role design.

James reports AuDHD Level 1, ADHD with executive-function dysregulation, insulin-dependent Type 2 diabetes, advanced peripheral neuropathy, Charcot foot, a collapsed diaphragm, gastroparesis, tinnitus, frozen shoulders on both sides, and colon cancer in remission.

The work-design implication is not that James cannot work. It is that job design matters: remote or hybrid work, written expectations, direct communication, reduced sensory load, predictable scheduling, limited unnecessary movement, breaks, and privacy-respecting accommodation discussions can materially improve fit.

## Interpretation Boundaries

- Do not inflate prototypes into enterprise products.
- Do not treat every project as equal in maturity or external validation.
- Do not claim formal credentials that are not documented.
- Do not frame health context as a reason James cannot work.
- Do not treat diagnoses as James's whole identity.
- Do connect claims to visible artifacts, source-grounded assistants, writing, and documented work patterns.
- Do distinguish confirmed evidence, reasonable inference, and unknowns.
